Delivered in `paper-repo` `dev` at f83190b (generated from `results/` as in `dev`; those files are identical to experiment-repo `main` a9410fc): `figures/` (6 PDFs + a `.md` caption note each), `tables/` (4 `.tex` + `.md`), and the generator in `figures/generate/` (`RESULTS_DIR=results FIGTAB_OUT=. sh figures/generate/make_all.sh` at the repo root).
  > 
  > **Placement** (names as you wrote them): `fig_headroom_ladder` and `fig_breakeven` → `figure*` (6.53 in wide; ladder 4.58 in tall, breakeven 3.59 in); `fig_regime_map` → `figure*` (6.58 × 3.54 in); `tab_main` → `table*`, `\centering\footnotesize\input{...}` (two stacked tabulars; fits 6.75 in). `fig_diagnostic` (2.89 × 2.77 in) and `fig_prop_check` (2.86 × 2.74 in) are single-column. Include every figure at its natural width (each `.md` says it): the smallest type is 7 pt there and shrinks if scaled down. Appendix: `tab_headline_full`, `tab_constructions`, `tab_side_info` are `longtable`s and do not work in two-column mode ("longtable not in 1-column mode"): put them after `\onecolumn` (I test-compiled them that way in the ICML style, no overfull boxes). `fig_breakeven_all` is a 9.8 in tall appendix figure.
  > 
  > **1. Forest reference n.** I kept n = 200: analysis's comment in experiment-repo#2 (07:46 UTC) says "Reference n (fixed before the runs): 500 for every set except forest (200)". `headline.csv` and its README say n = 500 for all, so those two analysis files disagree; the answer is analysis's (experiment-repo#8). If it is 500, I change `config.json` and regenerate. At forest n = 200 the selected interval has r = 1.007 (coverage 0.943, pre-fixed valid = 0); at n = 500, r = 1.001 (0.952, valid = 1). The range "0.971 to 1.005" in your Results is for forest at 500; with 200 the upper end is 1.007.
  > 
  > **2. Fonts.** Earlier PDFs were TrueType (none Type 3). They are now Type 1: `usetex` with Times, so all fonts are Nimbus Roman / CM Type 1. `pdffonts` on each: breakeven 4, breakeven_all 4, diagnostic 4, ladder 3, prop_check 3, regime_map 2 fonts, all `Type 1`, all embedded, no Type 3 (`sh figures/generate/check_fonts.sh` repeats this). My test paper with all six figures and the four tables, built with `icml2027.sty`, lists 27 fonts, all Type 1.
  > 
  > **3. Ladder caption numbers.** `fig_headroom_ladder.md` now lists n and N per dataset (n = 500 for all but forest at 200; N = 8000 alphafold, 5000 ballots, 1000 forest, 10000 the rest), the ratio range per rung (labels-only 1.152 to 2.857; PPI 0.999 to 1.053; calibrated f 0.971 to 1.020; selected A6 0.971 to 1.007; floor 0.993 to 1.004), and r, CI, coverage and valid per dataset for A6. The other notes carry the same "n per dataset".
  > 
  > **Still held:** B5 (`select_x`) at the reference n exists only for census_healthcare, so the B5 rung and `tab_main` column are not drawn (a "--" would read as either "no X" or "not run"). They appear when the other three rows land in `results/`; I regenerate and push, nothing to do on your side but the cross-reference.
  > 
  > **On your list in the update** (I only read the CSVs; what a column means is analysis's to confirm): (1) matches `breakeven.csv`, `calib_spline`, curve by curve: 3 of 5 bracketed quadratic designs (c = 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, all within the factor), 2 of 4 shapes (both within; tanh and nonmono left-censored), 5 of 5 stress bracketed with census_income_log the one miss (pred 42, win between 300 and 500), gene_expression the one bracketed real curve (miss), 8 real right-censored. (3) matches `diagnostic.csv`: 129 of 135 rows drawable (6 have no `pred_gain`), same sign 93.8%, Spearman 0.945. Items 2, 4, 5 (which of t1/t2 is linear) and 6 I did not check.
